thread:
sam_customer: Hey team, since yesterday our /embeddings calls started spiking tail latency and ~0.5% 400s. Only on prod region us-west2. Any idea? :confused:

julia_support: Sorry to hear that — can you paste a sample request + timestamp of failed calls? Is this all models or one specific embeddings model?

sam_customer: It's the 'open-embed-768' route. Example curl (redacted):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-xxxx" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"open-embed-768","input":["foo","bar","baz"]}'
```
Response: 200 usually but some requests take 6-9s and a few return 400 with body: `{"error":"dimension_mismatch: expected 768 got 512"}`

julia_support: Hmm weird — dimension_mismatch suggests mixed-dim payloads hitting the batcher. Do you have multiple clients sending different embedding dims to same key?

sam_customer: No, only our service -> SDK v1.2.1. We didn't change inputs.

matt_engineer: Jumping in. Can you send 3 example request IDs and timestamps? I'll check batcher logs and shard telemetry.

sam_customer: Sent in DM: req-9845, req-9852, req-9870 (timestamps 1724242001-1724242058).

matt_engineer: Looking at batcher logs on shard-07 around those times:
```
[1724242001] batcher: assemble window=12ms queued=14 max_batch_size=8 policy=dynamic
[1724242001] batcher: assembled batch_size=12 from clients=[c1,c2,c3]
[1724242001] batcher: mixed_dim_detected sizes={768:9,512:3} -> fallback to per-request route, respond with 400 dimension_mismatch
[1724242001] router: route selected variant=open-embed-768 (default) but fallback=open-embed-512
```

matt_engineer: The batcher assembled > max_batch_size (12 vs configured 8) — that's odd. Also I see mixed-dim clients in same batch. Do we have a config drift?

ryan_infra: We recently rolled a dynamic-batching optimization across us-west2. There's a feature-flag that allows oversubscribe on low-load windows (to improve throughput). It should still respect max_batch_size though. Pinging opsbot for rollout id.

opsbot: rollout-check: feature_flag/dynbatch_oversubscribe v=2026-02-14T03:12 applied to pool=us-west2 shards=0-15 (by ryan_infra).

ana_sre: I also see intermittent 401s from a legacy worker that was still using the old token; those 401s cause retries from the client which switch endpoint path (SDK does a fallback after auth error) — possible that two SDK versions are hitting same route with different default model param (512 vs 768).

julia_support: So combined: (1) oversubscribe allowed batcher to temporarily exceed configured max_batch_size, (2) mixed SDK versions sending different dims, (3) router fallback paths produced 400s. Sounds plausible.

sam_customer: Oh wow, we did roll one batch of sidecars yesterday with SDK v1.1.8 while most services were v1.2.1. Could that explain it?

matt_engineer: Yes — v1.1.8 defaults to model="open-embed-512" if env var MODEL is unset. v1.2.1 sets model="open-embed-768" explicitly. When both hit same tenant key, batcher groups them and then mixed-dim check triggers. Oversubscribe caused larger batch so probability increased.

julia_support: For immediate mitigation: 1) Pin SDK to v1.2.1 or ensure model param set; 2) We'll rollback the oversubscribe flag on us-west2; 3) I'll open a support ticket for per-tenant dim isolation.

matt_engineer: I pushed a changelist to enforce hard max_batch_size at batcher-queue (will roll in 5m) and added an alert for assembled_batch_size > max_batch_size.

ryan_infra: Rolling rollback of dynbatch_oversubscribe on us-west2 now.

opsbot: rollout-change: feature_flag/dynbatch_oversubscribe rollback initiated by ryan_infra (target shards 0-15).

sam_customer: After we pinned SDK and restarted a couple sidecars, latency looks back to normal. No more 400s for last 10m. Thanks. :raised_hands:

julia_support: Great. Follow-ups: - we'll add a tenant-level validation to block mixed-dim batches, - docs update to call out SDK default model mismatch, - escalation to engineering to consider safer sampling when oversubscribing. I'll attach logs to the ticket.

matt_engineer: Added a short repro script (python) you can run to see the mixed-dim case locally:
```python
import requests
url='https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings'
headers={'Authorization':'Bearer sk-test','Content-Type':'application/json'}
# client A (v1.2.1)
requests.post(url,json={'model':'open-embed-768','input':['a']},headers=headers)
# client B (v1.1.8)
requests.post(url,json={'model':'open-embed-512','input':['b']},headers=headers)
# then flood small concurrent requests to hit coalescing window
```

ana_sre: Filed INC-4321 for per-tenant dim isolation and added replication steps.

julia_support: Closing this thread for now, re-open if anything else pops up. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
